content.title: 3 Insurance Stocks We Steer Clear Of
content.summary: Insurance companies serve as the backbone of risk management, providing essential protection and financial security for individuals and businesses. Still, investors are uneasy as insurers face challenges from catastrophic events and potential regulatory changes. These doubts have certainly contributed to the industry’s recent underperformance - over the past six months, insurance stocks were flat while the S&P 500 was up 23.9%.
